messages:
billing-monitor-bot: ALERT: Detected sustained errors in billing-usage-pipeline (service=billing-display, error=missing_aggregates). ~2.3k customers may see invoice previews with 0 usage. Auto-page sent to #incidents and oncall.

carmen: seeing it, picking up. paging oncall (kevin) — attaching logs & quick triage.

kevin: oncall here. confirmed: hourly aggregation job failing at the join stage; recent schema tweak to usage_events table caused upstream job to drop nulls. error sample: `KeyError: 'customer_id'` from agg_worker. rolling forward safe-mode.

carmen: timeline so far — failure started ~2026-03-15T02:14Z (approx), first alerts at 02:20Z. Impact: invoice preview and dashboard tenant-level usage for some accounts; billing ledger ingestion unaffected. Customer charges will not be wrong but UI shows 0 or stale numbers.

kevin: immediate mitigation: 1) revert join-stage to prior code (hotfix branch) 2) restart aggregator cron job 3) enable metric to detect zero-usage spike. doing step 1 now.

kevin: ran `git checkout hotfix/revert-usage-join && helm upgrade billing-agg . -f values/hotfix.yaml` — rollout in progress.

carmen: +1. notifying finance & support. @aj please standby for comms draft, need to coordinate any customer-facing notices.

aj: thanks — finance here. priority: reassure customers that billing charges are not impacted and invoice generation will proceed once backfill completes. we need a short status page message + templated support reply.

maria: support lead — prepping a canned response for priority customers and a shorter public blurb for status.redwood.com. will hold until we have rollback confirmed + estimated backfill time.

kevin: rollout completed, all pods at desired state. aggregator logs show no KeyError now. restarting hourly job manually: `kubectl exec -it aggregator-0 -- /usr/local/bin/run_hourly.sh --start-from 2026-03-15T02:00Z`

billing-monitor-bot: INFO: Aggregation jobs restarted. Error rate returning to baseline. Metric: `billing.display.zero_usage_count` dropping from 2300 -> 120 -> 15 in last 10m.

carmen: good. next step: backfill window from incident start (02:00Z) to now. estimate: ~3 hours to process full backlog (depends on parallelism). I'll draft the status page + support template.

carmen: DRAFT status page (please review):
```
Status: Degraded
Component: Billing dashboard / invoice preview
Impact: Some customers may temporarily see 0 or stale usage in the dashboard and invoice previews. Actual invoicing (billing ledger) is not impacted. We are currently running a backfill to recompute usage for affected time window. Estimated time to restore accurate previews: ~3 hours. Updates will follow here and via email for impacted customers.
```

aj: looks good; add line: "No action required — charges will reflect correct usage once backfill completes." also include contact for high-risk enterprise accounts: `finance@redwood.com`.

maria: support template for incoming tickets:
```
Hi <Customer>,
Thanks for flagging this. We detected an issue that caused some dashboard previews to show 0 usage. Our engineering team has deployed a fix and is running a backfill. This will not affect billed charges; invoices will be correct. We expect dashboards to show updated usage within ~3 hours. If you need confirmation when your account is reconciled, reply and we will escalate to finance.
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

kevin: FYI for postmortem: root cause = schema change that filtered records with null customer_id without compensating downstream joins. Mitigation: add schema-change gating in CI for aggregation jobs + add integration test to detect dropped keys.

carmen: operational notes for handoff to next oncall (devon at 06:00Z):
- incident id: INC-20260315-02-billing-ui
- impact: ~2.3k customers saw zero-usage preview; invoice generation unaffected
- actions done: revert applied, aggregator restarted, backfill initiated starting from 2026-03-15T02:00Z, estimated 3h to completion
- owners: kevin (SRE) doing backfill monitoring; aj (Finance) on customer comms; maria (Support) queueing customer responses
- key artifacts: link to logs: https://logs.redwood.com/agg/1889012345, runbook: https://repo.redwood.com/runbooks/billing-agg.md

carmen: @devon please ack when you take over. leave any new updates in this thread.

devon: ack, taking handoff. I'll monitor backfill progress and validate dashboard snapshots for a sample of enterprise tenants. if backfill runs >5h, we'll open a customer-facing update with extended ETA.

billing-monitor-bot: UPDATE: backfill progress: 45% complete (processed 1.05M events). estimated remaining time 1.8h.

kevin: running reconciliation query to verify ledger vs preview numbers for a sample set:```
SELECT c.customer_id, ledger_sum, preview_sum, ledger_sum - preview_sum AS delta
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(charges) AS ledger_sum FROM billing_ledger WHERE ts >= '2026-03-15T02:00Z' GROUP BY customer_id
) l JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS preview_sum FROM preview_aggregates WHERE ts >= '2026-03-15T02:00Z' GROUP BY customer_id
) p ON l.customer_id = p.customer_id
WHERE ABS(ledger_sum - preview_sum) > 0;
```
kevin: initial sanity check shows ledger == expected, preview had zeros for ~0.1% of customers (the ones with nulls).

maria: support queue update: we've messaged 12 enterprise customers proactively (account owners list). no escalations yet.

aj: finance note: we'll run a reconciliation job after backfill completes to ensure invoicing data unchanged. if any invoice adjustments required, we'll prepare credits and outreach. previously run reconciliation should be quick since ledger unaffected.

billing-monitor-bot: COMPLETE: backfill finished at 2026-03-15T05:12Z. All preview aggregates recomputed.

kevin: verified dashboards sampling — numbers look normal. Ran reconciliation query again, no ledger-preview deltas found for tested customers.

carmen: STATUS: resolved. Closing incident after a brief monitoring window (2h). Draft final customer notification for audit trail:
```
Subject: Update: Billing dashboard display incident resolved

Hello,

We want to update you that an internal issue caused some customers to temporarily see 0 usage in the billing dashboard and invoice previews between 2026-03-15T02:14Z and 2026-03-15T05:12Z. This was a display issue only — actual billing calculations and invoices were not impacted. We have deployed a fix and backfilled the affected data. Dashboards now show correct usage.

If you believe your account still shows incorrect usage, please reply to this message or open a ticket and we'll escalate.

Regards,
Finance & Support at Redwood
```

devon: monitoring window started. no regressions so far. will close thread after 2h clear.

support-bot: Auto-note: incident INC-20260315-02-billing-ui -> status updated to RESOLVED (post-monitoring).

carmen: thanks everyone. follow-up items: 1) create PR to add CI gating for schema changes (owner: kevin) 2) add runbook step for quick rollback (owner: carmen) 3) finance to outline customer credit policy if ledger affected (owner: aj). I'll create tickets and link in postmortem.

kevin: on it — starting PR now.

billing-monitor-bot: incident timeline archived to https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-20260315-02-billing-ui

carmen: closing thread after monitoring window. great work team :thumbsup:
